d:
From Jaipur to Harvard, from the classroom to the US Congress, Pia Dandiya’s journey has reached a historic milestone. The Indian-origin Democrat has defeated Republican Casey Askar in Florida’s midterm elections, becoming the first Indian-origin woman elected to the US House of Representatives from Florida. A former teacher and school principal, Pia has also worked with the White House and Apple on education-related initiatives. Who is Pia Dandiya, and how did she make her way into American politics?
